Long Barrel (NTW-20).info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

AK107 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

Tec-9 Long Barrel.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Integral MC51.info: An integral suppressor for the STG-89C.

Front Post.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

1858 Long Barrel.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

Short Barrel (PISTOL).info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

Short Barrel (SHOTGUN).info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

SA58 Shorty Barrel.info:
A special aftermarket shorty barrel for your SA58 OSW to turn it into something familiar...
Combined stats of Short Barrel and Romanian Grip!

Snubnose Barrel.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

SCAR SC Integral.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK MK16 SOCOM SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walkspeed and handling!

Tec-9 Short Barrel.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

Kek-50 Long Barrel.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

Combat Barrel (DT11).info: A medium length barrel perfect for just about any engagement in normal circumstances. Improves close range performance slightly, speeds reload time and increases spread.

Short Barrel (SNIPER).info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

AUG A3 Integral Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

An integral suppressor designed for the UAR A3.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

Obrez Long Barrel.info: Fit your Obrez with an extended barrel, improving muzzle velocity but affecting other areas of the weapons performance.

Long Barrel (SNIPER).info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

Extended Barrel XIX.info: Extends your Mark XIX Desert Eagles barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

Lengthened Barrel.info:
Extended barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better range and bullet speed, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun. Worse movement.

AK12 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats. Three-round burst-fire becomes the main firing option, accuracy greatly improved with the BARS system.

Taurus Barrel (Judge).info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revolver.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Sawed Off Barrel.info:
A super short sawed-off barrel for your DT11 shotgun.
Further improves close range performance, reloads are a breeze but spread is massively increased.

AK109 BARS Barrel.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.
